mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.2% within the last month signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real GDP by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter signals strong economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the quarters where the GDP growth exceeds 1%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production by more than 1% month-over-month signals a weakening supply side, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as it indicates a potential economic slowdown.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2% within the last month, it signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200,000 and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 5% month-over-month and the real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) increase by more than 1% month-over-month, it signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 5% and RSAFS increases > 1% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% month-over-month for three consecutive months signals rising inflation, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) decreases by more than 1% month-over-month and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4%, it signals a supply-side slowdown combined with tight monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decreases > 1% in 1 month and FEDFUNDS > 4%
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.
